item.description:
Bugfix release 0.2.2.
- Export Notch shipping-funds APIs so Station builds and shows the sidebar funds glance. - Handle daemon `DEAD_LETTER` protocol errors in Notch connection UI. - Fix honesty chip fallback when last status is not a wire honesty dialect. - Fix agent spawn guard (`await` in `AgentSupervisor`). - Swift 6 Sendable on capture outbox types (Release CI). - Fix agent risk preview catalog import for release builds. - Working list invalidation chip covers `touched` level state.
**Unsigned build:** After download, drag to Applications, then **right-click → Open → Open** (or System Settings → Open Anyway). Quarantine applies to Sparkle updates too until we ship notarized builds.
